key_insight: A PDE-consistent deep neural network closure, trained inside the LES solver, can outperform classic eddy-viscosity models for turbulent premixed flames and generalize across Damköhler-number regimes.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical route to more reliable large-eddy simulations of reacting flows, improving prediction of mean fields, stress, and scalar transport with better robustness beyond the training regime.
method: Augmented eddy-viscosity closure represented by a deep neural network
Solver-in-the-loop training with adjoint-based optimization and differentiable programming
Joint calibration of the closure with the LES governing equations
evidence_signal: Against a Smagorinsky baseline, the best model reduced a posteriori primitive-variable errors by 25–50% and improved resolved Reynolds stress and scalar flux by more than 60%, while remaining stable out of sample across Damköhler numbers.
watch_item: Performance depends on careful solver-in-the-loop training and objective selection, so stability and transferability should still be checked for different flame configurations and operating conditions.
paper_title: Solver-in-the-loop training of deep learning closures for large-eddy simulation of turbulent premixed jet flames
